items.label: Current Z-hop
items.tooltip: Contains Z-hop present at the beginning of the custom G-code block.

items.label: Position
items.tooltip: Position of the extruder at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code travels somewhere else, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer knows where it travels from when it gets control back.

items.label: Retraction
items.tooltip: Retraction state at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code moves the extruder axis, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer de-retracts correctly when it gets control back.

items.label: Extra de-retraction
items.tooltip: Currently planned extra extruder priming after de-retraction.

items.label: Absolute E position
items.tooltip: Current position of the extruder axis. Only used with absolute extruder addressing.

items.label: Initial no support extruder
items.tooltip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used for printing without support. Same as initial_no_support_tool.

items.label: In head wrap detect zone
items.tooltip: Indicates if the first layer overlaps with the head wrap zone.

items.label: Current bed type
items.tooltip: Name of the currently selected bed plate type (e.g. 'Textured PEI Plate', 'Smooth High Temp Plate').

items.label: IDEX/IQEX active mode
items.tooltip: Name of the active IDEX/IQEX parallel print mode for this plate (e.g. 'primary', 'mirror', 'copy'). Empty string if IDEX/IQEX is not enabled.

items.label: IDEX/IQEX active mode index
items.tooltip: Zero-based index of the active IDEX/IQEX parallel print mode within imex_mode_names.

items.label: IDEX/IQEX active mode G-code
items.tooltip: The raw mode G-code template for the active IDEX/IQEX parallel print mode, after placeholder evaluation. Globals defined here flow into machine_start_gcode.

items.label: Current extruder
items.tooltip: Zero-based index of currently used extruder.

items.label: Current object index
items.tooltip: Specific for sequential printing. Zero-based index of currently printed object.

items.label: Has wipe tower
items.tooltip: Whether or not wipe tower is being generated in the print.

items.label: Initial extruder
items.tooltip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_tool.

items.label: Initial tool
items.tooltip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_extruder.

items.label: Is extruder used?
items.tooltip: Vector of booleans stating whether a given extruder is used in the print.

items.label: Number of extruders
items.tooltip: Total number of extruders, regardless of whether they are used in the current print.

items.label: Has single extruder MM priming
items.tooltip: Are the extra multi-material priming regions used in this print?

items.label: Volume per extruder
items.tooltip: Total filament volume extruded per extruder during the entire print.

items.label: Total tool changes
items.tooltip: Number of tool changes during the print.

items.label: Total volume
items.tooltip: Total volume of filament used during the entire print.

items.label: Weight per extruder
items.tooltip: Weight per extruder extruded during the entire print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

items.label: Total weight
items.tooltip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

items.label: Total layer count
items.tooltip: Number of layers in the entire print.

items.label: Print time (normal mode)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as print_time.

items.label: Print time (normal mode)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as normal_print_time.

items.label: Print time (silent mode)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in silent mode.

items.label: Total cost
items.tooltip: Total cost of all material used in the print. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.

items.label: Total weight
items.tooltip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

items.label: Total wipe tower cost
items.tooltip: Total cost of the material wasted on the wipe tower. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.

items.label: Wipe tower volume
items.tooltip: Total filament volume extruded on the wipe tower.

items.label: Used filament
items.tooltip: Total length of filament used in the print.

items.label: Print time (total seconds)
items.tooltip: Total estimated print time in seconds. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Print time (days component)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time day component (normal mode). Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Print time (hours component)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time hour component (normal mode). Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Print time (minutes component)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time minute component (normal mode). Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Print time (seconds component)
items.tooltip: Estimated print time second component (normal mode). Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Filament length (meters)
items.tooltip: Total filament length used in meters. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

items.label: Full input filename
items.tooltip: Source filename of the first object.

items.label: Plate name
items.tooltip: Name of the plate sliced.

items.label: Number of objects
items.tooltip: Total number of objects in the print.

items.label: Number of instances
items.tooltip: Total number of object instances in the print, summed over all objects.

items.label: Scale per object
items.tooltip:
Contains a string with the information about what scaling was applied to the individual objects. Indexing of the objects is zero-based (first object has index 0).
Example: 'x:100% y:50% z:100%'.

items.label: Input filename without extension
items.tooltip: Source filename of the first object, without extension.

items.label: First layer height
items.tooltip: Height of the first layer.

items.label: First layer convex hull
items.tooltip: Vector of points of the first layer convex hull. Each element has the following format:'[x, y]' (x and y are floating-point numbers in mm).

items.label: Bottom-left corner of the first layer bounding box
Top-right corner of the first layer bounding box
Size of the first layer bounding box
Bottom-left corner of print bed bounding box
Top-right corner of print bed bounding box
Size of the print bed bounding box
Bed temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of bed temperatures for each extruder/filament.

items.label: First layer bed temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of first layer bed temperatures for each extruder/filament. Provides the same value as first_layer_bed_temperature.

items.label: First layer bed temperature (initial extruder)
items.tooltip: First layer bed temperature for the initial extruder. Same as bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]

items.label: Chamber temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of chamber temperatures for each extruder/filament.

items.label: Chamber minimal temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of minimal chamber temperatures for each extruder/filament.

items.label: Overall chamber temperature
items.tooltip: Overall chamber temperature. This value is the maximum chamber temperature of any extruder/filament used.

items.label: First layer bed temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of first layer bed temperatures for each extruder/filament. Provides the same value as bed_temperature_initial_layer.

items.label: First layer temperature
items.tooltip: Vector of first layer temperatures for each extruder/filament.

items.label: Timestamp
items.tooltip: String containing current time in yyyyMMdd-hhmmss format.

items.label: Print preset name
items.tooltip: Name of the print preset used for slicing.

items.label: Filament preset name
items.tooltip: Names of the filament presets used for slicing. The variable is a vector containing one name for each extruder.

items.label: Printer preset name
items.tooltip: Name of the printer preset used for slicing.

items.label: Physical printer name
items.tooltip: Name of the physical printer used for slicing.

items.label: Previous extruder
items.tooltip: Index of the extruder that is being unloaded. The index is zero based (first extruder has index 0).

items.label: Next extruder
items.tooltip: Index of the extruder that is being loaded. The index is zero based (first extruder has index 0).

items.label: Relative e-axis
items.tooltip: Indicates if relative positioning is being used.

items.label: Toolchange count
items.tooltip: The number of toolchanges throught the print.

items.label: Old retract length
items.tooltip: The retraction length of the previous filament.

items.label: New retract length
items.tooltip: The retraction lenght of the new filament.

items.label: Old retract length toolchange
items.tooltip: The toolchange retraction length of the previous filament.

items.label: New retract length toolchange
items.tooltip: The toolchange retraction length of the new filament.

items.label: Old filament temp
items.tooltip: The old filament temp.

items.label: New filament temp
items.tooltip: The new filament temp.

items.label: X after toolchange
items.tooltip: The X pos after toolchange.

items.label: Y after toolchange
items.tooltip: The Y pos after toolchange.

items.label: Z after toolchange
items.tooltip: The Z pos after toolchange.

items.label: First flush volume
items.tooltip: The first flush volume.

items.label: Second flush volume
items.tooltip: The second flush volume.

items.label: Old filament e feedrate
items.tooltip: The old filament extruder feedrate.

items.label: New filament e feedrate
items.tooltip: The new filament extruder feedrate.

items.label: Travel point 1 X
items.tooltip: The travel point 1 X.

items.label: Travel point 1 Y
items.tooltip: The travel point 1 Y.

items.label: Travel point 2 X
items.tooltip: The travel point 2 X.

items.label: Travel point 2 Y
items.tooltip: The travel point 2 Y.

items.label: Travel point 3 X
items.tooltip: The travel point 3 X.

items.label: Travel point 3 Y
items.tooltip: The travel point 3 Y.

items.label: Flush Length 1
items.tooltip: The first flush length.

items.label: Flush Length 2
items.tooltip: The second flush length.

items.label: Flush Length 3
items.tooltip: The third flush length.

items.label: Flush Length 4
items.tooltip: The fourth flush length.

items.label: Layer number
items.tooltip: Index of the current layer. Zero-based (i.e. first layer is number 0), except in extrusion role change G-code, where it is one-based.

items.label: Layer Z
items.tooltip: Height of the current layer above the print bed, measured to the top of the layer.

items.label: Maximal layer Z
items.tooltip: Height of the last layer above the print bed.

items.label: Filament extruder ID
items.tooltip: The current extruder ID. The same as current_extruder.
